t: Backhoe for pool excavation? | Heavy Equipment Forums
s: August 8, 2006 - All the companies here dig pools with backhoes. ... I don't understand why everyone is so anti-backhoe. Back in the day before we had our excavators, we used to install sewer mains, water mains, dig foundations all with a backhoe. You can prolly pick up a nice 4wd backhoe cheaper than a mini-ex and skid steer. Ideally, the mini-ex and skid steer is the way to go, but you buy what will be in your best financial interests.
